_comment: Both commands run from the repo root rather than this directory. The lockfile lives there, and the example depends on the library as `link:../..` and resolves it through the `exports` map, which points at `dist/` — so nothing here can resolve `@saeris/hanko` until `vp pack` has run.
buildCommand: cd ../.. && yarn vp pack && cd examples/astro && yarn astro build
